expiry_proxy_definition: Use the close of the latest available 1-minute candle timestamped between 15:00 and 15:14 IST; ignore later candles.
note: Five-symbol/two-date data probe only. The final available candle by the 15:15 IST cutoff is accepted as the expiry proxy; this does not establish full-universe coverage, inactive-security history or official index weights.
